page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core. The memory configuration consists of 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor, lacks local storage, and does not include any GPU accelerators. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that the ecs.se1ne.2xlarge generally falls into the lower performance tiers for compute-heavy tasks. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests place the instance in the bottom 25% of tested hardware, with scores of 1105.78 and 5878.39 respectively. Similarly, single-threaded gzip compression and Geekbench single-core scores are in the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth tests show a weak read-only large block throughput of 39.24 GB/sec, though large block write bandwidth achieves an average rating at 34.3 GB/sec. Passmark CPU and extended instructions tests also register in the middle 50% tier.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio alongside lower-tier compute and memory read performance, this instance is suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high CPU throughput. Appropriate workloads include caching layers, lightweight database operations, and small-scale text or image processing. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which aligns with its 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a high density of RAM relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for memory-bound applications where raw processing speed is secondary to memory capacity.
